decision.platforms.2026-10-23.description: Current combined product direction: retain audience, daily dictation scope and modular contracts; add all-platform target with Mac-first development and final Windows/Linux verification.
decision.platforms.2026-10-23.rationale: The user explicitly targets all three platforms from the beginning, while developing on Mac and testing the others at the end. Source: source.platforms. Prior audience/scope answers remain unchanged and are carried forward from source.audience/source.release_scope. Original immutable records remain in reports/history.
